faction lowered: Order of the True Blood [ edit ] Description Lennea says, " Queen Ilyia has wisely chosen to forbid her citizens from speaking of the drake riders , but because we are sworn to destroy them, we must discuss them somewhat." "We aren't certain when the drake riders first took over Thelaseen , or even what their ultimate goals are. Regardless, rather than murder fellow elves , focus on slaying the breeding drakes ." "Without drakes , the Order of the True Blood becomes a manageable threat. We'll be able to deal with them if they make a move against us." [ edit ] Objectives Enter the drake roosts of the Order of the True Blood at Thelaseen , and slay broodmothers and broodlords. Return to Lennea Arrianth at the Wardship of the Sleeping Moon . Broodmothers \ (6) Broodlords \ (2) [ edit ] Upon Completion You will be given the following rewards: ?
